author: SickProdigy
description: Develop-only Polymarket connector with bot-first wallet and default-off trading foundations.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-user public Polymarket account and terms records, short-lived public challenges, optional encrypted session-key and CLOB-credential records with public provisioning, reconciliation, revocation, lifecycle, bounded retired-lifecycle history, and rotation state, Deposit Wallet deployment and Bridge funding records, immutable trade and cancellation approvals, active order lifecycle, bounded order history, rolling spend reservations, confirmation preferences, and a bounded digest-only audit, plus installation-wide safety settings. It fetches identity-bound public portfolio data and authenticated balance and open-order data without persisting those responses. Session private keys are authenticated ciphertext bound to the user and wallet profile; production trading remains default-off.
install_msg: Polymarket is a default-off connector to CryptoWallet. Bot-first Deposit Wallet, session-key, deposit, trading, and withdrawal work remains staged; no production capability is enabled.
name: Polymarket
